To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of social influence techniques can be effective in producing behavior change in applied settings, and that social psychological theory and laboratory research are relevant to applied problems.

(1) social psychological theory and methods can contribute to the solution of social problems, (2) this contribution can take the form of a teachable procedure, (3) the procedure can be tested and refined in laboratory experiments, and (4) the results of laboratory experiments can be used to guide the design of field experiments.

(a) social psychological theory, research, and methods can be used to help people solve problems of social concern; (b) the use of social psychological theory, methods and research to help solve problems of social importance is an important and useful activity for the social psychologist; (c) social psychologists should be trained in the skills needed to do such applied research; and (d) the use of applied social psychological research to solve problems of social significance should become a major activity of the discipline.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of social psychological theory and methods to problems of social importance.
applying social psychological knowledge and techniques to real-life problems.
applying social psychological theory and research to real world problems.

the research reported here is a successful application of social psychological research methods to the solution of practical problems.
